Break the import from `src/domain/billing.ts` to `src/presentation/invoice-view.ts`.

Why: it both closes the three-file cycle and violates the configured architecture rule that domain code cannot depend on presentation. The intended dependency direction should be presentation/application → domain, never domain → presentation.

Move invoice rendering/formatting into the presentation layer. If `billing.ts` only needs a type, extract it into a domain-owned leaf module or use `import type`; if it needs behavior, define a domain-owned interface and inject the implementation from `billing-flow.ts`. This removes the runtime edge while preserving the layer boundary.
